questions.question: Calculate 3 1/3 × 2 1/4, showing the conversion to improper fractions and any cancelling.
Explain with a diagram or words why 2/3 × 3/4 = 1/2.
questions.expected_answer: Shade 3/4 of a rectangle in columns, then take 2/3 of it in rows. The rectangle has 4 × 3 = 12 pieces and the double-shaded part has 2 × 3 = 6, so 6/12 = 1/2.

questions.question: Why is 3 × 2 + 1/3 × 1/4 the wrong way to multiply 3 1/3 × 2 1/4?
questions.expected_answer: A mixed number is a sum, so the products 3 × 1/4 and 1/3 × 2 are left out. The shortcut gives 6 1/12 instead of the correct 7 1/2.
